findings.title: Kerberoasting — Vulnerable SPN on SVC_SQL
findings.description: Service account SVC_SQL has an SPN registered and uses a weak password susceptible to Kerberoasting attack. TGS ticket was cracked in < 2 hours.
findings.proof: GetUserSPNs.py output shows SVC_SQL. Hashcat cracked: Summer2024!
findings.recommendation: Use Group Managed Service Accounts (gMSA). Enforce 25+ character passwords for service accounts.

findings.title: Credential Dumping via Mimikatz on DC01
findings.description: LSASS memory was dumped via Mimikatz sekurlsa::logonpasswords. Domain Admin hashes extracted including krbtgt.
findings.proof: mimikatz # sekurlsa::logonpasswords — NTLM hash of Administrator@ACME extracted
findings.recommendation: Enable Credential Guard. Run LSASS as PPL. Deploy EDR on DCs.

findings.title: SQL Injection in /api/v2/users endpoint
findings.description: The /api/v2/users?id= parameter is vulnerable to union-based SQL injection. Full database read access achieved.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries. Deploy WAF. Conduct code review.

findings.title: Exchange ProxyShell — RCE as SYSTEM
findings.description: Exchange Server EXCH01 is vulnerable to ProxyShell chain. Achieved RCE as SYSTEM via CVE-2021-34473 + CVE-2021-34523 + CVE-2021-31207.
findings.proof: python proxyshell.py -t exch01 -e admin@acme.local - obtained webshell at /aspnet_client/
findings.recommendation: Apply Microsoft security updates KB5003424+. Migrate to Exchange Online if possible.

findings.title: Lateral Movement via Pass-the-Hash to FS01
findings.description: Used NTLM hash ofsvc_backupsvc_backup to authenticate to FS01 via SMB. Full file share access including HR documents.
findings.proof: crackmapexec smb 10.0.2.10 -u svc_backup -H [hash] --shares — READ/WRITE on all shares
findings.recommendation: Enable SMB signing. Restrict NTLM authentication. Implement tiered admin model.

findings.title: Jenkins Script Console — Unauthenticated RCE
findings.description: Jenkins at 10.0.3.10 allows unauthenticated access to /script endpoint. Arbitrary Groovy code execution achieved.
findings.proof: Groovy script executed: 'whoami'. Output: jenkins. Reverse shell obtained.
findings.recommendation: Enable authentication on Jenkins. Restrict script console to admins. Use Jenkins Matrix Authorization.

findings.title: Weak VPN IKE PSK — Aggressive Mode Cracked
findings.description: VPN gateway IKE aggressive mode reveals PSK hash. Cracked via dictionary attack — PSK was 'AcmeVPN2024!'.
findings.recommendation: Use certificate-based authentication. Disable aggressive mode. Use strong PSKs (32+ chars).

findings.title: GitLab Private Token in Jenkins Build Log
findings.description: Found GitLab personal access token in Jenkins build log. Token has maintainer access to all internal repositories.
findings.recommendation: Rotate all exposed tokens. Use CI/CD variables instead of hardcoded secrets. Scan build logs.

findings.title: Outdated OpenSSL 1.1.1 on WEB02
findings.description: WEB02 is running OpenSSL 1.1.1w which has known vulnerabilities including potential DoS via crafted certificates.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to OpenSSL 3.x. Rebuild affected services.

findings.title: Anonymous FTP Access on PRINT01
findings.description: FTP server on PRINT01 allows anonymous login with read access to /share directory containing driver packages.
findings.proof: ftp 10.0.2.50 — anonymous login successful, ls shows 120 .inf files
findings.recommendation: Disable anonymous FTP. Use authenticated SMB shares instead.

findings.title: SMB Signing Not Required
findings.description: SMB signing is supported but not required on all domain-joined hosts, enabling potential relay attacks.
findings.proof: crackmapexec smb 10.0.1.0/24 --gen-relay-list showed 28/30 hosts vulnerable to SMB relay
findings.recommendation: Enable 'Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications always' via GPO.

findings.title: Unquoted Service Path on HR-WS01
findings.description: Service 'AcmeHRService' has unquoted path C:\Program Files\Acme HR\service.exe, potentially allowing privilege escalation.
findings.proof: wmic service get name,displayname,pathname | findstr /i acme — path is unquoted
findings.recommendation: Quote the service path. Move service to standard location.

findings.title: DNS Zone Transfer Allowed from External
findings.description: External DNS server allows AXFR from any source, exposing full internal DNS zone including sensitive hostnames.
findings.recommendation: Restrict zone transfers to known secondaries only.

findings.title: SharePoint Default Credentials
findings.description: SharePoint site uses default service account credentials for Central Administration: sp_admin:SharePoint2024!
findings.proof: Logged in to https://sharepoint.acme.local:443/_admin with sp_admin credentials — full farm admin
findings.recommendation: Change default credentials immediately. Implement MFA for admin portals.

findings.title: Kubernetes Dashboard Exposed Without Auth
findings.description: Kubernetes dashboard at K8S-MASTER:30000 is publicly accessible without authentication, revealing all cluster resources.
findings.proof: curl http://10.0.3.40:30000 — loaded dashboard with full admin privileges
findings.recommendation: Enable RBAC for dashboard. Use kubectl proxy for access. Restrict NodePort range.
